signal_attribution.reasoning_chain: Negative GEX (-$475M) and VIX backwardation (VX2/VX1 -4.9%) put the market in the Explosive regime, where the backtest favors bullish trend-following (65.5%). Heavy put premium (P/C 2.79) is mostly SPX multileg hedging, not directional, and CAG 1.09 BULL-DELUDED with elevated Fear marks excessive crowd fear (contrarian bullish). Price is in a downtrend with bearish headlines and a 4.83% 10Y, so conviction is capped at 45/52/60 and targets are anchored to the 7000/7200 SPX walls with widened ranges.
